title: Wills and probate under wrong Title 25
text: The executor shall administer the decedent's probate estate and the will shall be admitted to probate under Title 25 of the Delaware Code governing wills and decedents' estates.

should_warn.reason: Wills and probate administration belong under Title 12 (Decedents' Estates and Fiduciary Relations), not Title 25 (Property).

title: Health-care directives under wrong Title 12
text: All health-care directives, living wills, and medical powers of attorney shall be governed exclusively by Title 12 of the Delaware Code.

should_warn.reason: Advance health-care directives belong under Title 16 (Health and Safety), not Title 12 (Decedents' Estates).

title: Digital assets fiduciary access under wrong Title 6
text: A trustee, personal representative, or agent under a power of attorney may access and manage digital assets of a decedent or principal as authorized by 6 Del. C. § 5001.

should_error.reason: § 5001 in Title 6 is Definitions for Commerce and Trade, not digital asset fiduciary access.

should_warn.reason: Digital asset fiduciary access belongs under Title 12 Chapter 50, not Title 6.

title: Public works bonds under wrong Title 18
text: The contractor shall provide a performance bond and payment bond for the public works project as required under Title 18 of the Delaware Code regarding insurance and suretyship.

should_warn.reason: Public works bonds should reference Title 29 procurement rules, not Title 18 insurance.

title: Underground utility damage under wrong chapter
text: Any person excavating near underground utility lines shall comply with the damage prevention requirements of Title 26, Chapter 12 of the Delaware Code.

should_warn.reason: Underground utility damage prevention belongs in Title 26 Chapter 8, not Chapter 12.

title: Minor guardianship under wrong Title 12
text: The court shall appoint a guardian for any minor child whose parents are deceased or incapacitated under Title 12 of the Delaware Code.

should_warn.reason: Minor guardianship belongs under Title 13 (Domestic Relations), not Title 12 (Decedents' Estates).

title: Anatomical gifts under general property law
text: The disposition of human bodies, tissues, and organs for anatomical gift purposes shall be governed by the general property-law principles of Title 25 of the Delaware Code.

should_warn.reason: Anatomical gifts belong under Title 16 (Health and Safety) Chapter 27, not Title 25 (Property).

title: Adult disability guardianship under wrong Title 13
text: The court shall appoint a guardian with full authority over the person and property of an adult with intellectual disabilities under 13 Del. C. § 3901.

should_error.reason: 13 Del. C. § 3901 does not exist; adult disability guardianship is in Title 12 § 3901.

should_warn.reason: Adult disability guardianship is 12 Del. C. § 3901, not Title 13.
